subject: Successor Lead Coordinator deployment prompt staged for Gen7 continuity
body: A successor Primary/Lead deployment prompt has been staged with the current Gen7 architecture, Core V1 revision blockers, privacy/capture blocker, UI/bug-reporting requirements, hard 30/60s mesh cadence, regression-continuity gate, render policy and final reconciliation duties. It must fetch current main/board/integrity at startup and must not trust the bundled HEAD as current truth.
